To use your Chilly’s product properly the first time:

Disassemble removable parts (lid, collar, straw, etc.).
Wash everything thoroughly with hot, soapy water; don’t soak for long.
Air-dry fully, then reassemble following the product’s specific steps (align seals, click/lock lids, attach straws or loops securely).
Fill only with suitable liquids (no boiling, no carbonated in non‑fizzy‑safe lids) and keep it upright if it’s not fully leak-proof.

If you share which product you have (bottle, coffee cup, food pot, cutlery, etc.), I can walk you through the exact first‑use steps for that item.
